title: Annex B printed control-field qualification rows for real unmanned platforms

authority.edition: America's Aircraft, U.S. Military Aviation 1955-Present, 1 December 2025 Digital Update
authority.visual_review: 2026-10-30 native batch; page renders at artifacts/rules-book-wide-20261026/zcode-parallel-20261029/unmanned/source-pages/annexb-us-p70.png, annexb-us-p71.png, annexb-us-p72.png

scope: CONTROL fields only: control-link kinds, satellite control, printed LOS cap, printed controller platform roles, printed launch/recovery sentence. This table never certifies payload, equipment fit or endurance. Antenna geometry and endurance work assumptions remain explicitly scenario-authored; autonomous capability is not printed for either platform and cannot be claimed through an annex opt-in.

field_classes.source_printed: value read directly off the visually verified page
field_classes.source_printed_estimated: printed with the book's own e-/est. estimate flag; never promoted to a hard value
field_classes.derived_from_printed: computed from printed values with the formula stated; the usage pattern itself is a scenario assumption

is_uav.raw: UAV. Operates from runways. Controlled by SATCOM.

los_range_nm.note: page prints no LOS control-link range for this platform; silence is neither zero nor permission

acoustic_modem.note: air vehicle; the rules §2.5 acoustic modem is UUV-only

sensors_printed.note: Link 16 is a tactical data link (root Annex L registry), not a rules §2.5 control link

endurance_s_derivation.note: data meta-information only; engine endurance_s stays an explicit author work assumption, never certified here
